title: SaaS Price Increase Delta
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stripe:invoice vendor_name=* invoice_total_usd=*
| sort 0 vendor_name _time
| streamstats current=f last(invoice_total_usd) as prev_invoice_total by vendor_name
| eval price_delta_usd=round(invoice_total_usd-prev_invoice_total,2)
| where price_delta_usd>0
| sort - price_delta_usd
description: Shows positive jumps between one invoice and the previous invoice for the same vendor.
value: Price increases rarely feel urgent in the moment, but they compound quietly across a SaaS stack.
implementation: Pull Stripe or billing-email invoice totals into Splunk and compare each charge with the prior one for the same vendor.
visualization: Table of vendors with the latest positive invoice delta.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which subscriptions just got more expensive than they were last time.
